findings.note: Covers' game log lists 2.2 shots per game over his last 10 games through Oct 31, with 2+ shots in 8 of those 10. That includes 3 shots against LA on Oct 22. It does not cover any game after Oct 31.

In a Nov 8, 2026 report he had 28 shots in 16 games (about 1.75 a game) and 2 shots in the Nov 7 OT loss to New Jersey. It says he plays on the third line and the top power-play unit, a role that can add shot volume.

His player page shows 95 shots in 74 games last season, about 1.3 a game. Rotowire notes on the page say he isn't known to shoot the puck at a high rate. I found no injury or lineup news for him ahead of this game.
